{{Quote|They had fought separately, on the Ash Plains of Lenico and in the asteroid-hives of Gelpog the Tyrant.|Jedi Master Ngani Zho, on his apprentices|<ref name="Lost Suns 1" />}}
A '''conflict''' between the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the forces of [[Gelpog]] the Tyrant occurred during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The engagement was fought in Gelpog's [[Asteroid-hives of Gelpog the Tyrant|asteroid-hives]] and was participated in by at least one of the [[Padawan/Legends|apprentices]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ngani Zho]]&mdash;[[Satele Shan]], [[Syo Bakarn]], [[Jaric Kaedan]], and [[Bela Kiwiiks]].<ref name="Lost Suns 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle in the asteroid-hives of Gelpog the Tyrant was first mentioned in [[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 1|''The Lost Suns, Part 1'']]&mdash;the first entry in the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic Volume 3: The Lost Suns|''Lost Suns'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] story arc. ''The Lost Suns'' was written by [[Alexander Freed]] and released in [[2011]].
